meta.title: Nauta — by MADFAM
meta.description: Nauta is MADFAM's fractional-CTO operating system: one cockpit for your company's technology, operations and decisions. Learn more at nauta.quest.

hero.title: Your business, unified.
hero.subtitle: Nauta is MADFAM's fractional-CTO operating system: one login gathers every MADFAM service your company is entitled to —invoicing, scheduling, money, compliance— into one operations cockpit, with a technical operator when you need one. Its home is nauta.quest.

pillars.title: Why Nauta
pillars.subtitle: Not one more tool. The place where all your tools live together.

oneLogin.title: One login
oneLogin.description: One identity across the whole ecosystem. Sign in once and every service you're entitled to is right there —no twelve passwords, no twelve tabs.

salidaDigna.title: Yours to keep
salidaDigna.description: Dignified exit by design. If you ever leave the vCTO, the ERP and your data stay yours. You're never held hostage by your provider.

fiscalNative.title: Mexican-fiscal native
fiscalNative.description: CFDI, RFC and SAT compliance built in from day one —not bolted on afterward. Built to operate in Mexico, not force-fit to it.

vctoOnTap.title: A CTO when you want one
vctoOnTap.description: Rather have someone run it? Step up to the vCTO and a technical operator runs the stack for you. Move up or down a tier without losing anything.

closing.title: Start wherever it makes sense for you.
closing.subtitle: Plans, pricing and the full detail live at nauta.quest. If you would rather talk first, book a discovery call.
